title: What question is a square root asking?
text: $$\sqrt{81}$$ asks for the nonnegative number that multiplies by itself to make 81. A common mistake is to divide by 2 and answer 40.5. Which of these squares equals 81?

title: Confirm by multiplying
text: If 9 is the root, its square must be 81. What is $$9 \times 9$$?

title: Worked solution
text: $$\sqrt{81} = 9$$, because $$9 \times 9 = 81$$. Common mistake: answering $$40.5$$, or $$-9$$ when the radical symbol asks for the nonnegative root. General rule: $$\sqrt{a^{2}} = |a|$$. Check a square root by squaring your answer.
